reapack.name: ReaTooled_Special Paste + Trim Edges to Adjacent Items (Expand to fill, Loop Source and Section On).lua
reapack.desc: ReaTooled_Special Paste (Expand to fill gaps per track, Loop Source and Section On)

version.author: Brendan Baker
version.changelog: • REWORK: Gap detection, item identity, option guards, and right-neighbor locking all brought in line with ReaTooled_Special Paste v3.9. - GUID-based item diffing (collect_all_items_guid_set / diff_new_items) replaces pointer-identity snapshot, which is fragile after a paste operation. - Gap snapshot is taken BEFORE the paste on all tracks so the pre-paste gap geometry is available after pasted items occupy the gap. - Right neighbors are locked before paste and unlocked immediately after, preventing REAPER from deleting or damaging them when the clipboard item is longer than the gap. - Ripple mode is forced off for the operation and restored exactly afterward. - Auto-crossfade and "Trim content behind media items" are disabled for the operation and restored exactly afterward. - Arrange view is snapshotted and restored so the screen never scrolls. - EPS widened from 1e-6 to 1e-4 (0.1 ms) to match v3.9 and tolerate floating-point drift at high sample rates. - MIN_ITEM_LEN constant introduced to replace magic 0.0001 literal.

source.file: ReaTooled_Special Paste + Trim Edges to Adjacent Items (Expand to fill, Loop Source and Section On).lua

reapack.name: ReaTooled_Special Paste + Trim Item Edges to Next and Previous Items (Expand to fill between neighboring items).lua
reapack.desc: ReaTooled - ReaTooled_Special Paste + Trim Item Edges to Next and Previous Items (Expand to fill between neighboring items)

version.author: Brendan Baker
version.changelog: • FIX: Confirmed via console trace — get_anchor_track()'s heuristics (mouse hover / GetLastTouchedTrack / selected item) could resolve to a DIFFERENT track than the one REAPER's own native paste (40058) actually puts items on, since our script never drove REAPER's internal current-track state and was only guessing at it. When the guess was wrong, gap geometry (gap_start/gap_end/effective_gap_start) was computed for the wrong track while items landed on the real target track, producing exactly the reported symptom: gap not filled on the left, anchor track reported as different from the track actually pasted into. • FIX: get_anchor_track() removed entirely. Replaced with probe_paste_destination(): a real throwaway paste+undo run before the undo block opens (same pattern as clipboard_has_items()) that reads back, via reaper.GetMediaItemTrack() on the probe-pasted items, exactly which track(s) REAPER itself chose as the paste destination. The anchor track is now that observed topmost destination track — ground truth, not a heuristic — so it can never diverge from where the real paste lands afterward. This also subsumes the empty-clipboard check for the non-Razor path (previously only the Razor path checked upfront).

source.file: ReaTooled_Special Paste + Trim Item Edges to Next and Previous Items (Expand to fill between neighboring items).lua
